question: Select the correct combination of Indian classical dance and their respective dancer.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Elam Endira Devi__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Elam Endira Devi** is a highly regarded Indian classical dancer, known for her expertise in the** Manipuri dance** form, specifically in the **genres of Lai Haraoba and Raas**.
 
• She was born on **September 1, 1954**, in **Khwai Nagamapal Singjubung Leirak, Imphal, Manipur**. Her parents are Elam Bidhumani Singh and Elam Rosomani Devi.
 
• In **2014**, she was recognized with the **Padma Shri**, the** fourth-highest civilian award in India**. This honor was bestowed upon her by the Indian government, acknowledging her services to the field of art and culture.
 
• Since **2009**, **Elam Endira Devi **has been** a Life Member of the UNESCO Club Association of India**.
 
• Alongside her dance career, she has held numerous honorable positions within the field of art and culture.
